author: Codex /root/conformance_scope
review_scope: Independent source review of the expanded 13-file selection, process protocol, source/API immutable semantic projections, named consumer/AUnit replay, candidate bundle collector and final matrix gates. This excludes production runtime implementation and grants no source/API runtime pass, context acceptance or final matrix approval.

scope_selection.result: Installed selection metadata validates 13 actual primary files, 2493 source anchors, one helper and 159 APIs; 142 source and 159 API obligations remain pending.

resolved_findings.regression: Editing both the guard threshold and lexical condition is rejected by the source applicability binding.
resolved_findings.problem: A coordinated edit to both a measured guard and its linked lexical applicability descriptor could otherwise retain earlier source review.
resolved_findings.resolution: The definition now binds immutable source cross-review/proposal bytes. Current anchor,classifications,obligation links,invariants,configuration and measured descriptors must match the approved source projection.

resolved_findings.regression: Corrupted approval hash and five independent semantic descriptor drift mutations are rejected.
resolved_findings.problem: API invariant/scoped boundary text could otherwise broaden while approved named-case IDs remained unchanged.
resolved_findings.resolution: The scope and its selection approval now bind the independently reviewed API proposal. All159 current invariant,boundary,C/AUnit references and selected Lua obligation projections must match immutable approved bytes; status/evidence remain independently adjudicated.

resolved_findings.problem: Windows pretty JSON CRLF bytes could be reviewed locally but normalized to LF during Git staging, invalidating every dependent review hash on clean CI.
resolved_findings.resolution: The five owned reviews and math review were normalized to exact LF bytes, all dependent API and selection identities cascaded, and first-party reviewed inputs now reject CRLF, BOM and invalid UTF-8. Synthetic metadata writers emit LF; native process captures are preserved unchanged.
resolved_findings.regression: Actual Git staging/checkout reproduces changed CRLF review bytes, and three raw-byte invalid forms are rejected even when the supplied worktree hash matches.

resolved_findings.problem: Expanded final matrix replay could otherwise omit separate warning-regression indices retained by the GC/events child campaign.
resolved_findings.resolution: Collection and matrix shape now require exactly one warning index per each of 26 contexts. Independent matrix approval binds their hashes; replay derives six default or eight instrumented target/case pairs, checks actual scripts, payloads, phase, abort/control transport, source and executable/library identities, and rebases hashed captures.
resolved_findings.regression: Missing child/context warning evidence, changed reviewed hashes and rejected process/source/payload/noise/phase/runtime mutations fail. The shared active verifier has 21 focused regressions, including Linux converted normal and shutdown signals.

reviewed_guarantees: The required scope cannot shrink its own 13 original-source identities or bwcoercion helper; exact 159 selected public header IDs and both semantic review identities are immutable selection inputs.

Per-process source-profile witness measures integer/mantissa/exponent/endian/precision facts without consuming the RNG. Declarative typed guard evaluation records false native alternatives as reviewed references without passing inactive assertion bodies.

Instrumented coroutine execution requires hook tail and both actual public C API sections. Default omission reports require genuine linked instrumented runtime obligations. Unexpected omissions or diagnostics fail.
Both separately seeded unchanged constructs templates are mandatory in every context,  with actual branch output and source/copy hashes. No RNG replacement or fabricated branch coverage is accepted.

Expanded public foreign consumers execute the identical 48 public-header contracts against Ada and separately built pinned C. Named source hashes,  unique completion/case witnesses, empty stderr and exact C/Ada captured bytes are replayed.

AUnit replay binds exact registered names/current sources, complete actual suite count, zero failures/errors and exact expected warning bytes. Generic source text, wrong chunk names and appended stderr are rejected.

Final matrix acceptance requires 26 distinct contexts, clean final checkout revision, reviewed source/contract/equivalent identities, actual measured launcher configurations, 900 second / 2 GiB policy, balanced allocator shutdown and matching runtime/oracle libraries across files, C consumers and AUnit.

Independent reconciliation binds all primary/supplemental process reports, contracts and named consumer/AUnit identities. A successful observation or pending author mapping alone carries no acceptance authority.

The artifact collector requires every context and named report, verifies original reports paths/hashes/revisions, refuses duplicates/partial indices and cannot overwrite a matrix with review metadata. Its output remains diagnostic until separately reviewed.
CI jobs select one PR head revision and preserve raw reports, captures, equivalents and process evidence for later independent replay.

Mandatory warning replay covers 26 unique context indices and 170 actual process cases across the supported context matrix: six cases in each default context and eight in each instrumented context. A record cannot waive rejection by changing its expected flag.

One shared case generator and active verifier govern warning capture and replay. Exact normal/shutdown payloads distinguish Ada and native chunk names; controls require empty stderr, shutdown requires prior OK, and platform abort transports cannot hide unrelated diagnostics.
Reviewed first-party text must be UTF-8 without BOM and LF, matching immutable repository bytes; source hashes are never silently normalized. Native captured output remains untouched.

independent_checks.notes: Synthetic protocol regressions plus current source/hash checks. Fourteen existing final-runtime Windows captures independently pass the new shared verifier as diagnostic corroboration. No foreign-platform or final runtime/context acceptance is inferred.

remaining_gates: All 142 source obligations and 159 selected API obligations still need actual clean-revision evidence in their required contexts.
Execution-contract review, source/API runtime adjudication, all 26 contexts and final independent matrix acceptance remain separate obligations.
Full M3, unselected primary files, aggregate/heavy and unrelated global ABI/ecosystem claims remain outside this bounded decision.
newline_identity: Reviewed as exact UTF-8 without BOM and LF repository bytes. Captured stdout/stderr retain original native bytes and hashes.
